body.message:
Good morning, thank you for letting me know. That’s unfortunate as I was very interested in the apartment and was planning to proceed with the viewing this weekend.

Could you please check whether you have any other 1-bedroom apartments available in La Sirène, La Rive, La Côte, Le Pont or elsewhere within Port de La Mer, ideally around a similar price range?

I am looking to move in this month and would initially be interested in a 3-month stay, paying monthly. My preference would be around AED 8,500 per month all-inclusive, or as close to this as possible.

If you have anything suitable available now or becoming available shortly, please send it through as I am ready to move quite quickly.
